hero.title: Change management & training
hero.description: The system gets installed, but the team doesn't adopt it. Our organizational change management works on adoption from day one of the project, not as a closing activity.

intro.pullQuote: Adoption is worked from day one, not at project close.
intro.description: We integrate change management into project execution, focused on minimizing digital transformation risks caused by resistance to change — and we measure organizational climate and the adoption curve continuously with AI, not just at project close.
bullets: Continuous measurement of organizational climate and the adoption curve, with AI.

pillars.title: Four pillars, one adoption process
pillars.description: Our Change Management methodology isn't an add-on: it's embedded in our Strategy, Select, and Project Management services. This ensures change management that aligns perfectly with your organization's vision and objectives.

items.title: Stakeholder management
items.description: We identify and manage all interested parties to ensure their active participation and support during the change.

items.title: Communication plan
items.description: We develop effective strategies to keep everyone involved informed and engaged at every stage.

items.title: Training plan
items.description: We design personalized plans to ensure the team is prepared and confident using the new solution.

items.title: Climate management
items.description: We monitor and manage the project's emotional and cultural environment to foster a collaborative setting.

distinctive.description: At Cyrrus CS we don't see change as an obstacle, but as an opportunity for growth and improvement. Our comprehensive Change Management approach shapes organizational culture, making it more flexible and oriented toward continuous success.
bullets: Proactive management of the organization's impact, minimizing any operational risk.
Holistic methodology applied to Select, Strategy, and Project Management.
Radical reduction of the natural friction in adapting to new metrics and technology solutions.

items.question: When does change management work actually start?
items.answer: From day one of the project, not as a closing activity — it's embedded in the execution of Strategy, Select, and Project Management, not run as a separate service.

items.question: How do you measure whether the change is actually being adopted?
items.answer: We measure organizational climate and the adoption curve continuously with AI, not just with a survey at project close.

items.question: Is team training included?
items.answer: Yes, the training plan is one of the four pillars of the process. Our broader training programs, including generative AI adoption for senior management, live at Cyrrus Leadership Academy.

items.question: Can you help if the system is already installed but the team isn't using it?
items.answer: Yes. While the ideal approach is integrating change management from the start of the project, we also step in when adoption has already stalled, through stakeholder management, a communication plan, and organizational climate management.
